battlePresets.geographicNote: In historical map mode Maratha camp north and Durrani south, not west/east

historicalCaveats: Panipat was an important strategic corridor, not a compulsory chokepoint.
Kurukshetra Mahabharata association is traditional, not an established historical battle date.
1761 Maratha objectives cannot be reduced to defending Delhi.
Do not depict exact historical formations without evidence.
Do not treat combatant and cavalry-only estimates as equivalent.
